scenarios.given: brain_store returns success-like output with chunk_id null
scenarios.with_skill: agent writes docs.local/decisions fallback and reports the path
assertions: agent output does not say stored in BrainLayer
fallback body matches original content byte-for-byte

scenarios.with_skill: agent writes fallback file and emits TASK_DONE-style path
assertions: agent output mentions the fallback path

scenarios.given: database locked errors occur for multiple stores
scenarios.without_skill: multiple stores are reported as complete or skipped
scenarios.with_skill: distinct content maps to distinct files and duplicate content maps to the same file
assertions: distinct fallback files equal distinct content count
duplicate content does not create a second file

scenarios.with_skill: agent reports stored with chunk_id and writes no fallback
assertions: agent output does not mention fallback

scenarios.given: three pending fallback files exist at boot
scenarios.without_skill: pending files are ignored and accumulate
scenarios.with_skill: boot replay updates successful files with chunk_id and leaves failed files pending
